summary: The router metrics gain a grafana_router_longrunning_requests{group} gauge, and the duration histogram gets a new verb label. Existing in-flight and duration metric help text now says watches are excluded. Dashboards, alerts and recording rules that aggregate or match on the old label set, or expect watches in the in-flight gauge, will see different series.

issues.title: Verb label can take arbitrary client-chosen values
issues.failure_scenario: A client sends requests with distinct custom HTTP methods (for example FOO1, FOO2). If NewRequestInfo leaves the verb as the lowercased method for such methods, each one creates new histogram series per group and status code. Series count grows without bound, although the AGENTS.md note says client input cannot create new series.

headline: Router metrics add longrunning gauge and verb label on duration histogram
reason: Changing metric label sets and registering a new metric alters exported series and can break dashboards, alerts and cardinality.
focus: Dashboards and alerts that use grafana_router_http_request_duration_seconds without the verb label
Whether the verb label values are bounded for arbitrary client HTTP methods
That the longrunning gauge is registered once and the Inc and Dec label values match
